requested_by: Amy — "Please keep a log of all your questions and follow up's and the status of each. I need this to keep track of any open questions that I need to address."
how_this_works: Built from the datasets themselves on every run rather than maintained by hand, so it cannot drift out of date: close a gap in a stage and the item leaves this list. Answered items are kept with their answer, because a question that quietly vanishes is indistinguishable from one that was forgotten.

owners.town: Needs a records request or an answer from Town of Hillsborough staff.
owners.county: Needs a records request or an answer from Orange County staff.
owners.amy: A modelling or editorial decision that is hers, not extractable.
owners.david: An account-level action only the repository owner can take.
owners.pipeline: Work this project can do without anyone else.

register.question: Annual revenue FY18-FY25 and forecast assumptions.
register.why_it_matters: From your Questions_for_Town sheet; it needs a records request or a staff answer.
register.answer: Answered by the town's records-request response 'Sales Tax Information.docx', which gives FY18-FY25 receipts with a PDF page cite for each, the FY26 original budget ($3,233,500) and year-end estimate ($3,408,000), and the forecast assumption in staff's own words: FY27-29 are held flat at $3,408,000 because growth has slowed over 3-4 years and the source is volatile. It also explains the collection lag — the state receives and redistributes, so May sales reach the town in July.
